script.title: AT THE LICENSE COUNTER
script.story_hook: A young driver renews his license, name and all.
script.intro_zh: 一位年輕司機來換駕照,連婚後的姓名也一起改。
script.welcome_en: Hi! Today: renewing a driver's license at the counter.
script.welcome_zh: 你好!今天來學在櫃台換駕照的對話。
script.outro: Sixty lines, and the license office feels easy now.
script.outro_zh: 六十句聽完,監理處也不再可怕。
script.practice_intro_en: Your turn — say each line out loud with me.
script.practice_intro_zh: 換你了,和我一起大聲唸每句話。
script.char_a_description: a young man in his late twenties with short black hair and a thin beard, wearing a denim jacket over a plain white T-shirt, blue jeans and white sneakers, slim build, holding a manila envelope
script.char_b_description: a middle-aged woman with straight dark brown hair in a low ponytail, wearing a light blue button shirt under a gray office vest, black slacks and flat shoes, average build with rectangular glasses

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, ticket B-12 — is this the renewal line?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ˈtɪkɪt bi twɛlv ɪz ðɪs ðə rɪˈnuəl laɪn/
dialogue.zh: 你好,B-12號,這是換照的隊伍嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is. Counter three, ID please.
dialogue.zh: 是的,三號櫃台,請給我看證件。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here's my old license, it expired last month.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪrz maɪ ˈoʊld ˈlaɪsəns ɪt ɪkˈspɪərd læst mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 這是我舊駕照,上個月過期了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No problem — under thirty days is fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈprɑbləm ˈʌndər ˈθɜrti deɪz ɪz faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題,過期沒超過三十天都好辦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great. What documents do I need?
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我需要帶什麼文件?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Proof of address and your social card.
dialogue.phonetic: /pruf əv əˈdrɛs ænd jɔr ˈsoʊʃəl kɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 住址證明,還有你的社保卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I think I brought everything you need.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ θɪŋk aɪ brɔt ˈɛvriθɪŋ ju nid/
dialogue.zh: 我應該把該帶的都帶齊了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect. May I see your proof?
dialogue.zh: 很好,可以給我看看證明嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um… my bill's in my other jacket.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm maɪ bɪlz ɪn maɪ ˈʌðər ˈdʒækɪt/
dialogue.zh: 呃……我的帳單放在另一件外套裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So no proof of address right now?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ noʊ pruf əv əˈdrɛs raɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 所以你現在沒有住址證明?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I have a bank statement — does that count?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæv ə bæŋk ˈsteɪtmənt dʌz ðæt kaʊnt/
dialogue.zh: 我有一張銀行對帳單,那個也算嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How old is the statement?
dialogue.zh: 那張對帳單是多久以前的?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's from last week.
dialogue.zh: 上週才開的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then that works. Sign here, please.
dialogue.zh: 那就可以了,請在這裡簽名。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done! Is there a vision test today?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn ɪz ðɛr ə ˈvɪʒən tɛst təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 簽好了!今天要做視力測驗嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just this — read the eye chart.
dialogue.zh: 只要這個——請唸視力表。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Line… seven? Then eight?
dialogue.zh: 第七排……然後第八排?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good. Any trouble with night driving?
dialogue.zh: 不錯。晚上開車會看不清楚嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only after dark, to be honest.
dialogue.zh: 老實說,只有天黑以後會有點吃力。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll note glasses after sunset.
dialogue.zh: 我們會註明:日落後要戴眼鏡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice — those help me a lot.
dialogue.zh: 太好了,夜間眼鏡真的幫我很多。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now the photo — face the camera.
dialogue.zh: 接下來拍照,正面對著鏡頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How's that? Too serious?
dialogue.zh: 這樣可以嗎?看起來太嚴肅?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost — you blinked. One more.
dialogue.zh: 差一點,你眨眼了,再拍一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did I blink again?
dialogue.zh: 我又眨眼了嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! No, this one's great.
dialogue.zh: 哈!沒有,這張很棒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So when do I get the card?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wɛn du aɪ ɡɛt ðə kɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 那我什麼時候會拿到卡?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It mails out in two weeks.
dialogue.zh: 會用寄的,兩週後寄到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two weeks? I drive to work!
dialogue.zh: 兩週?可我每天開車上班耶!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Relax — this paper covers you.
dialogue.zh: 別擔心,這張臨時紙照就能用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A temp license? It looks like a receipt.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə tɛmp ˈlaɪsəns ɪts lʊks laɪk ə rɪˈsit/
dialogue.zh: 臨時駕照?看起來像一張收據。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it with your old card.
dialogue.zh: 把它跟你的舊照放在一起。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I photograph it on my phone?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ ˈfoʊtoʊˌɡræf ɪt ɑn maɪ foʊn/
dialogue.zh: 我可以先用手機拍下來嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea — officers like that.
dialogue.zh: 好主意,臨檢的員警也喜歡看手機裡的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What's the fee for four years?
dialogue.zh: 效期四年的費用是多少?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thirty-eight. Card or cash?
dialogue.zh: 三十八塊,刷卡還是付現?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Card. Any student discount?
dialogue.zh: 刷卡。有學生優惠嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry, not at twenty-nine.
dialogue.zh: 不好意思,二十九歲就沒有學生價了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair. Does my license number change?
dialogue.zh: 有理。那我的駕照號碼會變嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same number — renewals keep it.
dialogue.zh: 號碼不變,續換都是沿用同一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, and my new name — when?
dialogue.zh: 對了,我婚後的新名字,什麼時候改?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did you bring a marriage certificate?
dialogue.zh: 你有帶結婚證書來嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes! It's in the envelope.
dialogue.zh: 有!就在這個信封裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect — then it prints today.
dialogue.zh: 太好了,那今天就能改好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait — the mailed card gets the new name?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt ðə meɪld kɑrd ɡɛts ðə nu neɪm/
dialogue.zh: 等等——寄來的新卡就會印新名字?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly. Keep the paper close.
dialogue.zh: 沒錯。先把那張紙照收好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And if I lose this paper?
dialogue.zh: 那如果我把紙照弄丟了呢?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stop by anytime, we reprint it.
dialogue.zh: 隨時回來,我們再幫你重印一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You made a scary place easy.
dialogue.zh: 你讓這個可怕的地方變得好簡單。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's kind. Here's your folder.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝誇獎,這是你的資料袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need a written test too?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid ə ˈrɪtən tɛst tu/
dialogue.zh: 我還需要再考筆試嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No — renewals skip the test.
dialogue.zh: 不用,續換不必重考。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Seriously? Best news today.
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎?這是今天最好的消息。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One tip — check your address line.
dialogue.zh: 給你一個提醒,確認一下地址那一欄。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It says… my old apartment!
dialogue.zh: 上面寫的是……我舊公寓的地址!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fix it now — the statement helps.
dialogue.zh: 現在就改,你的銀行對帳單可以用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There — the new place. Thanks!
dialogue.zh: 改好了,是新住處。謝謝你!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done. Reminders mail sixty days ahead.
dialogue.zh: 完成。之後到期前六十天我們會寄提醒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. Thanks for all the patience.
dialogue.zh: 太好了,謝謝你這麼有耐心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Drive safe — see you in four years!
dialogue.phonetic: /draɪv seɪf si ju ɪn fɔr jɪrz/
dialogue.zh: 開車小心,四年後再見!

"Did I blink again?" — the scariest two seconds at the license office. In this 60-line A2 listening animation, a young driver renews an expired license at the counter: showing his ticket number, proving his address with a bank statement, reading the eye chart for night driving, retaking the photo after one blink, getting a paper temporary license, and adding a brand-new married name in the same visit. Listen line by line, then repeat every sentence out loud in the shadowing chapter. Polite, funny, and packed with real counter English. No memorizing — just listen often. Designed for A2 learners.
